flags.why: The water-spinach sense is still current; [VDict](https://vdict.com/mu%E1%BB%91ng%2C2%2C0%2C0.html) marks the shortened form as uncommon, not archaic.
flags.fix: Replace archaic with uncommon; retain in-compounds.

flags.why: Learners are much more likely to encounter muống referring to water spinach, especially in rau muống, than referring to a funnel.
flags.fix: Put the water-spinach sense first and the funnel sense second.

flags.why: Lương dân meaning innocent civilians belongs to literary or formal narration and is misleading as an unmarked everyday term.
Hiến dâng has a solemn, formal or literary register rather than the everyday register suggested by the unmarked gloss.
The example defines quasars instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Các nhà thiên văn vừa phát hiện một chuẩn tinh rất sáng. = Astronomers have just discovered a very bright quasar.
